GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT

Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department–Positioning of Volunteers @
one per around 50 households in the State to ensure leak proof implementation of
Government Programmes/ Schemes –Orders –Issued.

PANCHAYAT RAJ & RURAL DEVELOPMENT (MDL-I) DEPARTMENT

G.O.Ms.No.104

Dated:22.06.2019

Read:

From the Commissioner, PR & RD, Tadepalli, Guntur
Note/Letter.No.575/RWS/2019, dated:11.06.2019.

## ORDER:

Government is committed to revamp delivery systems in the State with an
aim to improve living standards of the people through the concept of
**NAVARATHNALU** as core theme of governance. In order to operationalize
Navarathnalu, Government intends to deploy Volunteers in rural areas for delivering
Government Services at door step of all eligible households irrespective of
Caste/Creed/Religion/Gender and political affiliation. This system will ensure
leak proof implementation of Government Programmes/Schemes. The objective
of positioning Village Volunteers is to ensure timely and transparent services, to
eliminate the corruption at all levels of administration. Village Volunteers will
identify the problems being faced by anybody in his jurisdiction and the same will be
brought to the notice of Gram Panchayat and then get them resolved.

1. Accordingly, the Commissioner, PR & RD has submitted proposals on
2. procedure for selection, imparting training and positioning of the Volunteers and
3. requested to permit for commencing the process for selecting Volunteers @ one per
4. around 50 households in the State by 15th August, 2019. Further, he has also
5. requested to permit him to incur an expenditure of Rs.13.50 Cr. (Rupees Thirteen
6. Crores and Fifty Lakhs Only) for recruitment and training and Rs.1,200 Cr. (Rupees
7. One thousand Two Hundred Crores Only) per annum for payment of honorarium to
8. positioned volunteers @ Rs.5,000 /- per volunteer per month. He has formulated the
9. following guidelines for positioning of Village Volunteers.
11. I. NOTIFICATION:
12. The Notification shall be issued in Telugu in two Telugu Daily News Papers by
13. the District Collectors concerned.
15. II. NUMBER OF VOLUNTEERS:
16. The Number of volunteers shall be arrived by the respective District Collectors.
18. III. ELIGIBILITY:
19. The applicant must belong to the village/Gram Panchayat for which she/he is
20. applying.
22. IV. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:
23. The applicant must pass Intermediate (or) its equivalent exam in plain areas
24. whereas 10th Class or its equivalent pass in Agency/ Tribal Areas.

## e) RESERVATION:

Rule of reservation is applicable as per the rules in vogue. 50% of posts within each
category will be considered for women. Wherever vacancies arised due to non
availability of certain communities those vacancies may be filled with other available
communities. First, Mandal should be taken as the unit for fixing RoR. In case, no
candidates of a particular category are available in the Mandal, District may be
taken as the unit. But, in the scheduled tribal areas only ST candidates shall be
appointed. In case, in a particular village in the Scheduled area no eligible ST
candidate is available, the same may be appointed from the adjacent village.

## f) AGE:

The applicant shall be of at least 18 years of age as on 01.11.2019 and shall have
not exceeded 35 years.

## g) HOW TO APPLY:

The candidates shall apply online through Website link gramavolunteer.ap.gov.in

## h) METHOD OF SELECTION:

All eligible applicants shall be called for interview by the Selection Committee
consisting of MPDO/ Tahsildar / EO(PR&RD).

The interview board will select the most eligible applicants based on the following
parameters:

1. *1. Behavioral Skills-15 marks**
2. i. Value System [Honesty, Discipline, Morality]
3. ii. Empathy for the poor
4. iii. Social Responsibility
5. iv. Result Orientation
6. *2. General Awareness - 20 marks**
7. i. Various Government Programmes and Welfare Activities
8. ii. Social and Local Problems
9. iii. Village Development Plans [his/her ideas]
10. *3. Soft Skills - 15 marks**
11. i. Leadership Qualities
12. ii. Good Communication Skills

Each member of interview board will award marks to each applicant in the interview
for a maximum of 50 marks. The average marks (of the three) obtained by the applicant
out of 50 will be reckoned for selection of Village Volunteers.

The letter of engaging the services of selected Village Volunteers will be issued by
the Chairman of the Selection Committee, i.e. MPDO.

1. i) HONORARIUM:
2. The selected applicants will be engaged as volunteers on honorarium basis for the

15. Roles and responsibilities of Village Volunteers will be as prescribed from time to
